newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-DORTMUND THROUGH TO LAST EIGHT OF EUROPEAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND THROUGH TO LAST EIGHT OF EUROPEAN.

text.p: Borussia Dortmund scored a late goal to qualify for the quarter-finals of the European Cup with a 2-2 draw against Widzew Lodz in the Champions' League on Wednesday.

International defender Juergen Kohler scored the crucial goal in the Group B encounter in the 62nd minute with a well-timed tap-in from a corner kick which assured the Germans their place in the knock-out stage of the competition.
They have 10 points in Group B and go through with Spain's Atletico Madrid, who have the same tally with one round of Champions' League matches to come.

But the German champions had to fight their way back after Polish striker Jacek Dembinski scored twice in five minutes in the first half after Paul Lambert had given Borussia the lead with a goal from 12 metres out in the 13th minute.

Dembinski scored in the 15th and 19th minutes as Widzew mounted fast and effective counter-attacks in the first half. The German side adjusted well after the interval and controlled the pace of the game for most of the second half.
